scheme: Three digits, each 0-9, counting up like an odometer: 1.0.0, 1.0.1 ... 1.0.9, then 1.1.0 ... 1.9.9, then 2.0.0. Every change bumps the last digit.

entries.title: Benchmarks are optional
changes: Performance Benchmarks: any benchmark can be cleared back to unset (a Clear link on the card and in the editor), and a target of 0 is no longer accepted.

entries.title: Performance Benchmarks redesign
changes: Settings → Meta Performance → Performance Benchmarks is redesigned: a colour guide, one section per funnel (TOF, TOM, MOF) with six benchmark cards each, and a right-hand editor with a live colour preview.

Set or edit a target from its card; several reporting windows per measure are shown together in the card. Change history is now a collapsed section at the bottom. All existing benchmarks, rules and history are unchanged.

entries.title: Funnel checkboxes and per-funnel benchmarks
changes: Performance: the Funnel dropdown is replaced by TOF / TOM / MOF checkboxes (all selected by default, Select all, n of 3 selected) that filter the ad table only; the summary cards keep their scope.

Benchmarks are now set separately for each funnel and measure (CPA, ROAS, Outbound CTR, CPM, Reach, Frequency, with an optional Frequency range); each ad is coloured only against its own funnel's benchmark, and unset measures stay uncoloured.

entries.title: Performance & Best Ads refinement
changes: Performance: 20 ads per page with numbered pagination and a visible total; search now covers ad name, Meta Ad ID, product and concept across the whole dataset.
Best Ads now shows unique creatives: Meta ads whose names differ only by trailing Copy suffixes are grouped into one card with combined Purchase Value, Purchases, Amount Spent, CPA and ROAS.
Clicking a creative shows its performance by funnel (TOF / TOM / MOF) and every underlying Meta ad, each with its own preview.

entries.title: Best Ads page
changes: Meta Performance now has a Best Ads page: a gallery of the best-performing Meta ads ranked by purchase value, with Rank By, Funnel, Campaign, Status, Minimum Spend, Search and Include DPAs filters.
Meta Performance in the sidebar expands to Performance, Best Ads and Ad Matching; the date range and Previous period carry across pages.
Each card is one Meta ad with its real creative, Purchase Value, Purchases, CPA, Reach, Amount Spent and ROAS, and opens the existing Ad Preview.

entries.title: Meta ad preview: redesigned two-column modal
changes: The ad preview now shows the real Meta preview on the left (with Meta preview / In-app player switch and an asset strip when Meta gives several assets) and Ad Details, Performance and Links & Actions on the right.
Meta Ad ID and the full ad name can be copied; Refresh Preview refreshes only the preview.
Dynamic creative now has a short note instead of a warning panel.

entries.title: Meta Performance: clearer KPI comparisons, ad names, row hover
changes: KPI cards compare with the previous period (one decimal, favourable or unfavourable only where it is clear; Reach and Frequency show unavailable).
Ad names are slightly smaller, semibold, two lines at most.
Hovering a row now lightly highlights the whole row without losing the column shading.

entries.title: Version tracking begins
changes: The version now shows at the bottom of the sidebar; click it to see this history.
Starting point for numbering. Earlier work was not versioned one change at a time; it is included here.
Planning: Core, High Stocks and the Shoot Plan with a weekly target of 15 new concepts; the Weekly Plan is retired.
Meta Performance: new layout with KPI panels, previous-period comparisons, a date range picker, DPA exclusion, and real creative previews.
The WNDRR wordmark in the sidebar now takes you to the Dashboard.
